(END-TO-END EXERCISE — MILESTONE CASE) A BSP team lead hands you this summary after a hard on-call week:

  'We stabilized LPDDR6 on our new SoC. Two weeks in, we hit:
    1. ECC counter spike on sub-channel 2 (tracked to VDD2H ripple during DVFS)
    2. UFS 4.1 WBPF flush that caused a camera burst drop (tracked to HAL integration gap)
    3. sched_ext BPF watchdog trip on prime cluster (tracked to a select_cpu infinite loop)
    4. Qualcomm Glymur TSENS bias (tracked to missing nvmem-cell propagation in BL2).

  All four are fixed. Management wants a post-mortem + lessons-learned meeting. Please guide us through writing it.'

Apply the full mentor workflow. Structure the post-mortem: symptom-restatement per issue, resource-probe chain, hypothesis-fanout across domains, convergence, and a cross-department summary. Recommend what to sediment into the BSP knowledge graph (FailureModes, new eval cases) so next team doesn't repeat the same path.
